mapper.select: SELECT u.username, u.user_profile_url, tp.career, tp.total_average_rating, (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id),0) FROM enrollments e JOIN trainings t2 ON e.training_id = t2.training_id WHERE t2.trainer_id = tp.trainer_id) AS total_trainee_count FROM trainer_profiles tp JOIN users u ON tp.trainer_id = u.user_id WHERE tp.trainer_id = #{trainerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trainer_profiles (trainer_id, career, total_average_rating, total_trainee_count) VALUES (#{trainerId}, '안녕하세요! 잘 부탁드립니다.', 0.0, 0)
